_comment: Configuration for leakage-free feature selection benchmark

prefilter._note: Pre-filter runs INSIDE each training fold only. Two runs: main (5000) and sensitivity (2000).

mw_filter.description: Univariate Mann-Whitney U test, top k by p-value

lasso.description: L1 logistic regression, rank by |coef|, top k

elastic_net.description: Elastic net logistic regression, rank by |coef|, top k

stability_selection.description: Repeated subsampling (stratified) with L1 LR, rank by selection frequency
stability_selection._runtime_note: Heaviest method. ~1-3 min per outer fold.

svm_rfe.description: Linear SVM recursive feature elimination until k remain
svm_rfe._runtime_note: Step 20% at a time from pre-filter size. ~5-20s per outer fold.

mrmr.description: Greedy maximum relevance - minimum redundancy (pure numpy, no extra package needed)
mrmr._runtime_note: O(k * prefilter_size) per fold. ~2-5s per fold.

rf_importance.description: Random Forest feature importance (mean decrease in impurity), top k

cv._note: Outer: 5-fold x 10 repeats = 50 outer folds. Inner: 3-fold for classifier hyperparameter tuning only.

permutation_test._note: Run on best (selector, k) combo only to confirm above-chance performance. Uses reduced repeats for speed.

baseline_reproduction.description: Reproduce existing top-5000 ANOVA + RandomForest under correct repeated nested CV

parallelism._note: Used for outer fold parallelism. Inner loops are sequential to avoid nested parallelism overhead.

known_markers._source: Literature (clinical methylation markers for cervical pre-cancer)
known_markers._note: These are for biological sanity checking only, not validation. Do not report overlap as confirmation.
